rules.idea: New York 16:45-18:00 every day (2026 US DST boundaries hardcoded = all the data): the last 15 min before the 17:00 NY break (Friday = weekly close, open trades force-closed 20:58:58 UTC) and the dead hour after it
Friday from 16:45 New York - the weekly-close subset of rule_daily_break (small: 8L/14W)
New York 17:00-18:00, the hour after the daily break - subset of rule_daily_break
what rule_daily_break adds beyond the api.py example window 20:45-21:15 UTC (the existing market-close rule)

filled 1.2+ pips past the UHV level (threshold picked on train only). CAVEAT: the fill is the first tick 0.3 s AFTER the trigger (buy at ask), so this acts at the fill, not before the order; EA form = max-spread / max-slippage guard; the spread is what Python models worst - MT5 first
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    return (t['fill'] - t['level']) * t['side'] / 0.0001 >= 1.2

rules.idea: rule_overshoot on buys only (ask fill: mostly the spread); same fill-time caveat
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    return t['side'] > 0 and (t['fill'] - t['level']) / 0.0001 >= 1.2

rules.idea: recommended pair: rule_daily_break OR rule_overshoot (the overshoot half acts at the fill and needs MT5)
the breakout tick itself (known at the decision) printed 0.8+ pips past the level - tiny (4L/26W) and adds 0 losers beyond the recommended pair
mean tick volume of the last 30 closed candles <= 25 (train-only pick = 26) - redundant with rule_daily_break: outside that window it is not selective (rule_dead_tape_outside_break)
rule_overshoot on sells only (bid fill: gap + 0.3 s drift) - high lift but only 3 losers, fewer than the 4 required
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    return t['side'] < 0 and (t['level'] - t['fill']) / 0.0001 >= 1.2

rules.idea: rule_dead_tape outside NY 16:45-18:00
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    ts = float(t['t_in'])
    loc = ts + (-14400 if 1772953200 <= ts < 1793512800 else -18000)
    sod = loc % 86400
    if 16 * 3600 + 45 * 60 <= sod < 18 * 3600:
        return False
    k = int(t['k'])
    return float(A.v[k - 29:k + 1].mean()) <= 25

rules.idea: Friday New York 15:00-16:45 (thin Friday afternoon) - train x4.96 but test x0.00 (0 losers in 55)
last 10 candles at <= half the pace of the 50 before (train x1.99, just short)
camStk <= -5 (old downtrend, sells)

def rule(t, A):
    return t['camStk'] <= -5

rules.idea: level within 1.5 pips of a 100-pip figure, either side
breakout in the first 10 s of a :00 minute
breakout minute already >= 90% of the UHV's ticks at the break
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    return t['brk_ticks_so_far'] >= 0.9 * t['uhv_v']

rules.idea: UHV >= 2.2x the 30-candle mean (climax / stopping volume)
UHV <= 0.8x the 30-candle median (not a real volume peak) - a batch-5 coincidence: 14/21 losses vs 8/42 twins, x1.4 on all trades
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    k = int(t['k'])
    x = sorted((float(q) for q in A.v[k - 29:k + 1]))
    return t['uhv_v'] <= 0.8 * (x[14] + x[15]) / 2

rules.idea: level broke within the first 6 ticks of the minute
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    return t['brk_ticks_so_far'] <= 6

rules.idea: first hump of the new colour while the 90-bar trend is 10+ pips against the trade
level within 2 pips of the 60-bar extreme ahead AND last 10 candles 30% quieter
price ran 25+ pips from the opposite 60-bar extreme to the level
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    k, side, lvl = (int(t['k']), t['side'], t['level'])
    run = lvl - A.l[k - 59:k + 1].min() if side > 0 else A.h[k - 59:k + 1].max() - lvl
    return run / 0.0001 >= 25

rules.idea: 10+ of the last 20 candles straddle the level
loud UHV (>= 1.8x) whose far end is the 60-bar extreme behind the trade
>= 2 swing points (60 bars, before the UHV) within 1 pip of the level
rules.code:
def rule(t, A):
    k, ku, side, lvl = (int(t['k']), int(t['ku']), t['side'], t['level'])
    hs, ls = A.pivots(k, 1, 60)
    pts = hs if side > 0 else ls
    return sum((1 for j, x in pts if j < ku and abs(x - lvl) <= 0.0001)) >= 2

batch_notes: All numbers are a Python tick-replay HYPOTHESIS (CLAUDE.md: only MT5 / live fills can promote). Each rule's source was exec'd in a fresh namespace and scored by api.report; the code strings are exactly what was scored. rule_ids list only rules that pass the bar (GOOD / EXCELLENT); non-selective rules that also touch a loss are named in its comment. WHAT THE CHARTS SHOW: in all 21 losses the bid never came back to the fill (best excursion 0.0 to -0.6 pip) - every loss is a breakout tick that was the exact turning point, after which price drifted 20 pips over 16 min to 12 h. The twins are usually the same setup in the same zone minutes earlier, so bar structure (S/R touches, range tops, exhaustion, counter-trend humps, climax UHVs, chop, round figures, repeat entries) does NOT separate losers from winners: every structural rule scored lift 0.5-2.2 (NOT SELECTIVE). WHAT DOES SEPARATE: liquidity and execution. (1) rule_daily_break, NY 16:45-18:00 (DST-correct: the dead zone is 21:00-21:59 UTC in summer, 22:00-22:59 UTC in winter): 16L/108W, x4.49 train / x8.06 test. Its core is Friday's last 15 minutes (8 of 22 trades lose, mostly small forced closes at 20:58:58 UTC, plus Good Friday 2026-04-03's four -$525..-$819 gap losses) and the dead hour after the break (Mon-Thu 21:30-21:45 UTC: 4 of 18 lost). It adds 5L/45W beyond the api.py example window. Window choice disclosed: I compared windows with train and test printed together; on train alone NY 16:45-17:30 ranks first (x5.58 train / x7.95 test); I shipped 16:45-18:00 (x4.49 / x8.06) because the minute-volume table shows the whole 17:00-18:00 NY hour is dead (median 5-9 ticks); both pass on both halves. Extending Friday back to 15:00 NY fails out of sample (0 losers in 55 test trades). (2) rule_overshoot, fill >= 1.2 pips past the level (train-only pick = 1.2): 14L/102W, x3.13 / x10.73 - but the fill is the first tick 0.3 s after the trigger (buy at ask), and the signal is mostly post-trigger (spread + drift: post-trigger part >= 1.0 pip = 11% losers, trigger-tick gap alone only 4L/26W). It is a fill-time guard, not a pre-entry filter, and the spread is exactly what Python models worst. The two overlap (wide spreads at the break); union 22L/187W, x3.16 / x7.45, WR 97.74 -> 97.98%. rule_dead_tape (<=25 ticks/min, GOOD alone) adds only 3L/90W beyond the pair. In batch 5, 1 loss (0617-205108-S) is removable before entry and 1 more (0527-123601-B) at the fill; the other 19 are indistinguishable from their twins with anything measured. Not tested as harness rules (need other trades, not t/A): repeat entries at the same zone (same side, within 1-3 pips, last 10-60 min) - lift 0.6-1.5, NOT SELECTIVE. Files: agents/batch_5/rules.py (all rules), run.py (exec + score), results.log / results.json (scores), features.py + scan.py (feature scan), final.py -> final_output.json.
